scope: W0 first public Z/Flux one-shot supervisor; not yet JobStore-wired
identity_lifetime: waitid WNOWAIT before last signal; waitpid reap only after final group cleanup signal; never signal PID/PGID after reaping
complete: leader reaped AND owned process group absent
deadline_or_identity_loss: cleanup_pending; admission retained; explicit pollCleanup may release after OS confirmation
limitations: Deadline observation depends on OS scheduling; no hard realtime promise
Process groups are the ownership boundary; supported workers must not call setsid/setpgid to escape
Admission and PID ownership are process-local; durable restart identity/pending-job integration is still required
